site.context: Jizan Red Sea coastal sabkha process brine (Basyoni & Mousa 2016 Table 2 means); Red Sea regional screening, not a Yanbu/Oxagon/Sokhna concession sample, not Red Sea desal feed

meta.quality: Majors cited from Basyoni & Mousa 2016 Environmental Earth Sciences Table 2 Jizan sabkha brine averages (Ca, Mg, Na, K, Cl, SO4). HCO3 103.3 mg/L omitted (not in SUBSTANCES). No Li+ or Br- in that table — omitted. Banat et al. 2005 is Jeddah–Yanbu sabkha geography, not a second ion table. Not a concession sample.
meta.notes: Ion masses converted from tabulated mg/L to g/kg with density 1.12 kg/L (screening from ~167 g/L TDS band — not a CTD). mol_per_kg = g_per_kg / molarMassG from engine/model SUBSTANCES. Literature numbers are preferred over forcing charge balance. salinity_g_per_kg is the summed cited ions, not the TDS headline. Not Red Sea seawater desal feed; literature assay is not a mineral concession.
